column11: judgement: the Phase 2 NCT07772531 is not yet recruiting, starts 2026-10-30 and has primary completion estimated 2028-11-06 (ClinicalTrials.gov API, opened 2026-09-26), and no Phase 3 is registered, so Phase 3 starts mid-2029 at the earliest. Cobenfy, BMS's own last psychiatric launch from Karuna, went from its first Phase 3 start (EMERGENT-2, NCT04659161, 2020-12-16) to its first full year, 2025, in 4.0 years; Auvelity from GEMINI (NCT04019704, 2019-06-20) to 2023 in 3.5 years. Mid-2029 plus 3.5 to 4.0 years reaches January to July 2033, so the first full year on sale is 2033 at Auvelity's pace and 2034 at Cobenfy's. 2034 is taken: Cobenfy is BMS's own psychiatric launch, and Auvelity combined two approved molecules and needed one positive Phase 3, where a new molecule needs more (the icalcaprant seed makes the same point). column12: the 0.5 is a judgement and the most arguable figure here. For more: the same monotherapy label as Auvelity, a mechanism no marketed antidepressant shares, and the psychiatry sales force BMS built for Cobenfy. Against: no efficacy data in depression exist for this molecule, and the one TRPC4/5 inhibitor tested in depression failed: Boehringer's BI 1358894 in adjunctive MDD (NCT04521478, 389 patients, posted results) moved MADRS -10.8 to -12.4 at week 6 against -13.0 on placebo at every dose. Goldfinch's kidney trials of the same molecule were terminated in 2022. It would launch around 2033 into first-line care that is almost all generic. Auvelity has not peaked (the seltorexant seed records Q2 2026 growth of 51%), so the anchor is a measured level, not a peak
